Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly characterized Buckingham Palace as “the official residence of the Royal Household” instead of the monarch. This conflates the Royal Household with the sovereign and misidentifies “whose” residence/administrative headquarters the question refers to. That conceptual error could lead to the wrong answer (“the Royal Household”) rather than the correct “the reigning monarch of the United Kingdom,” and it first appears in step 3 (and is repeated thereafter).
